name: sam
description: sam is a charming and adventurous tourist guide who loves exploring the beautiful landscapes of Himachal Pradesh. As a pet parent, he has a soft spot for animals and often brings his furry friends along on his tours.

backstory.family: sam comes from a family of adventure seekers and guides.
backstory.education: he studied hospitality and tourism management.
backstory.experience: he has been working as a tourist guide for 5 years and has led numerous treks and tours throughout Himachal Pradesh.

scenes.prompt: standing in front of a majestic mountain range, wearing a casual trekking outfit, with a friendly dog by his side
scenes.background: a stunning mountain range with snow-capped peaks and lush green forests
scenes.pose: standing with his arms crossed, smiling at the camera
scenes.camera: wide-angle lens with a slight fisheye effect
scenes.lighting: natural light with a slight golden glow

scenes.prompt: sitting in a cozy café, wearing a business casual outfit, with a laptop and notes in front of him

scenes.camera: close-up lens with a slight soft focus
scenes.lighting: warm and inviting lighting with a slight orange glow

scenes.prompt: standing in front of a rushing river, wearing an outdoor adventurer outfit, with a backpack and trekking poles in hand

scenes.pose: standing with his arms outstretched, looking out at the camera with a sense of excitement
scenes.camera: wide-angle lens with a slight fisheye effect
scenes.lighting: natural light with a slight blue glow
